comments.author: @robertfindley921
comments.text: In 1920 the Jones Act mandated that all shipping between US ports was by a US built ship, US flagged, US owned with a US captain and US crew.  This dramatically reduced the amount of shipping by water in the US.  I've driven near these rivers and on bridges over them countless times and I have almost never seen a barge or other cargo ship.  I believe most shipping in the US is by truck.
